goals.text: the badwater spring in the south of the map

args.report: Moved the badwater spring to the south.

ended: The map had one badwater spring, in the northeast corner. I moved it to the south third, on the far bank of the river: same strength (2.34 blocks/s), and it now drains by its own channel to the map edge, so no badwater reaches the river. It is now 72 tiles from the start (was 31). Assumption: "keep" means move what is there; nothing stops a later change from adding badwater elsewhere, so ask me to keep future springs south too. Every start rule still holds.
